sources.label: Beyonder Morphe patches
sources.author: Beyonder
patch_list: Disables the installer/signature validation that exits the app on re-signed builds when the operator enables it, and the restricted-app block that refuses to run while network-analysis tools are installed.

Unlocks premium content playback and downloads, removes the buy-premium paywalls, disables all ad placements, and hides the expired-subscription nag. Server-side restrictions such as account device binding remain.
